name: Reinette Kirsche
source:
Self-proclaimed genius mage studying at the Flor Hermos Magic Academy, as a 3rd grade student from the advanced course (high school). Reinette runs "Smile Magic Store" and has a strong sense of opposition to [url=/c5276]Parfait[/url], who owns the rivaling "Black Cat Magic Store". Reinette's attitude and tone are always confident and straightforward, although sometimes she says words that are contrary to her true intentions. Her mother died at an early age, but she has a younger sister named [url=/c56343]Cocotte[/url] and a father who is the court mage. The latter is a very busy man, so he rarely comes home.
